long_text.title: Premium wear
long_text.body: Discover premium resort wear by Red Panda Resort, where effortless elegance meets island-inspired style. From refined everyday essentials to elevated vacation outfits, find comfortable, timeless pieces made for sunlit escapes and memorable moments.

items.name: The Lagoon Breeze Cabana Towel
items.description:
Wrap yourself in pure luxury after a dip in the Maldivian sea with the Azure Tide Cabana Towel by Red Panda Resorts.

This premium, oversized towel features a crisp, sophisticated design with bold stripes in deep lagoon breeze and calming seafoam green, perfectly mirroring the mesmerizing colors of the Indian Ocean and the lush scenery around your overwater villa. Crafted from ultra-soft, highly absorbent cotton, this towel provides the plush comfort expected of a five-star resort experience.

A final, elegant touch of branding is embroidered at the hem: the flowing cursive of "Red Panda Resorts" followed by our signature Red Panda logo, a subtle reminder of your exclusive tropical escape. It's the ultimate essential for your sun lounger, infinity pool, or private beach day.

long_text.title: On using swimming products
long_text.body: Dive into the beauty of island living with our exclusive swimming collection, thoughtfully curated for sun-soaked days, refreshing ocean swims, and unforgettable moments by the water. From stylish swimsuits and comfortable swim shorts to versatile rash guards and lightweight beach essentials, every piece brings together comfort, functionality, and effortless tropical style.

items.name: Tidal Weave Swimsuit
items.description:
Dive into island life with the Sunset Ember Tidal Weave Swimsuit. Rendered in a stunning, vibrant coral hue, these swimming trunks are designed for both high performance and sophisticated leisure. The quick-drying, high-performance fabric features a subtle woven texture, ensuring a seamless and stylish transition from the water to the beach bar or boardwalk.

Technical Details

  • Custom Detail: Embroidered black bamboo logo on the lower left leg.

  • Fabric Composition: 100% Recycled Performance Polyester.

  • Weave: Lightweight, textured basketweave provides quick-dry capabilities and comfort.

  • Fit: 6-inch inseam; tailored, mid-thigh length.

  • Features: Full elastic waistband with an adjustable drawstring, convenient side seam pockets, and a rear patch pocket with a drainage grommet.

  • Lining: Soft and supportive internal mesh brief lining.

  • UV Protection: UPF 50+ sun protection built into the fabric.

  • Care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Hang dry recommended.

  • SKU: TS-SW-SE85
